name: How to Split a PDF Free
description: Split a PDF into separate files or extract specific pages — free, no upload, processed locally in your browser.

tool.name: PDFree — free browser-based PDF splitter, no upload required

step.name: Open your PDF
step.text: Click 'Choose files' or drag your PDF into the drop zone. Page thumbnails render in your browser — nothing is uploaded to any server.

step.name: Select the pages you need
step.text: Click individual page thumbnails to select or deselect them, or enter a range like '1-3, 5, 8-10'. Use quick-select buttons for odd pages, even pages, or halves. To delete pages, select everything except those pages.

step.name: Choose output: one file or separate files
step.text: Select 'Extract pages' to get your selected pages as one merged PDF, or 'Split all pages' to get every page as its own PDF file in a ZIP archive.

step.name: Download the result
step.text: Click 'Split PDF'. Your extracted pages download immediately — as a single PDF or a ZIP of individual pages.
